understanding.goal_understanding: Reach the goal gem tile marked + in each level, completing the current BP35 level and continuing until the game is won, while avoiding spike tiles.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: MOVE_LEFT and MOVE_RIGHT shift the player horizontally, after which gravity carries the player until landing, hitting a hazard, entering a new section, or reaching the goal. Gravity direction determines whether the player falls toward smaller or larger y-values. Landing on spikes ends the attempt. CLICK with a target position removes clickable breakable blocks without moving the player and does not advance the rising-platform timer; clicks should open useful gravity paths. UNDO reverts the previous action. Each level allows two attempts and has a turn limit, so landing previews and corridor passages should guide movement.
